giver.name: Section Officer Vetch
giver.via: in person, with the stores docket

said: Collect from the instrument makers. Sign here, here, and on the reverse. … Second period first. Then the city. Back to me by nineteen hundred.
title: Collect the levelling bubble
brief: One compound levelling bubble from the instrument makers in the city, signed for, back to Vetch by nineteen hundred.

want.stated: An instrument part, for an instrument.
want.gm: To find something wrong with Section Nine before they've done anything. There is no such part: he hazes every new section.

deadline.cost: A direct order. Refusing one is "the most serious thing you can do here".

parts.detail: A lesson, the workshop or the range: your own choice.

parts.text: Collect one from the instrument makers
parts.detail: In the city. Sign the docket here, here, and on the reverse.
parts.strikeNote: "There's nothing in the bubble. That's the whole point of the bubble."

parts.text: Requisition a new vial against the docket, exactly as he wrote it
parts.detail: "It needs a signature from a desk above his."

parts.text: Go back and tell Manako how it went
parts.detail: He asked. The tea house, his table.

closes: Their paper is in at the stores hatch before nineteen hundred.
suggestedRecord: Day 1, afternoon. Section Officer Vetch handed Section Nine a docket for one compound levelling bubble, to be back by nineteen hundred. The instrument makers laughed: there is nothing in a bubble. In a tea house a few streets on, a man called Manako told them to take Vetch at his word and requisition a new vial against the docket, exactly as written. It went in at the stores hatch before nineteen hundred.
notes: Says what was asked, never how: whether they file it quietly or loudly is theirs (The Errand's choice). Manako's request stays open when this closes and becomes a loose end in the Record, by Ingram's choice (D057), so the tracker never pulls them back to the tea house.
